description: This file defines classes related to PDF key metadata management within the PDFsharp library, including KeyDescriptor and DictionaryMeta classes for handling PDF dictionary keys and their types.

classes.name: KeyDescriptor
classes.description: Represents metadata about a key in a PDF dictionary, including its type, version, and object type.

classes.name: DictionaryMeta
classes.description: Contains meta information about all keys of a PDF dictionary, including methods to retrieve key descriptors.

methods.name: KeyDescriptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing KeyDescriptor from a KeyInfoAttribute, setting version, key type, fixed value, and object type.

methods.name: GetValueType
methods.description: Returns the .NET Type corresponding to the PDF key type, using ObjectType if specified, or inferring from KeyType.
